authority: User authorized unused weights and other unused files to be deleted
weight_sha_policy: Historical verified download SHA recorded; pre-delete stat/inode/size/mtime and accessible fd/maps checked, no new bulk SHA scan
process_scan_limit: Accessible processes only; permissions prevented some system process inspection
replay_requirement: Retired official teacher weights must be re-fetched from saved pinned revisions before historical replay; prior reports/configs/tokenizers/indexes/receipts remain preserved.
